name: Permanent Magnets Ltd
title: Permanent Magnets Ltd-$ - 504132 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Permanent Magnets' FY26 growth rested on a new Alloys furnace and Relays/rare-earth lines that slipped; Relays commercial ramp moved to H2 FY27 and rare-earth revenue was nil in FY26, so FY27 guidance of 20-30% growth is unproven.

utilisation.quote: utilization was almost at about 80%, 90%, almost full capacity we utilized until the end of the year

capex.peers_comment: Management said multiple players are setting up rare-earth magnet capacity, with 5-6 companies expected to set up, some applying for PLI.
capex.quote: It could be between INR 40 crores to INR 50 crores for PML itself and another INR 40 crores to INR 50 crores could be the plan in Quantum, roughly.

triggers.label: Relays ramp slips to H2 FY27
triggers.quote: we are behind the original timelines with commercial ramp-up now expected from second half of financial year '27

triggers.label: Alloys furnace ~80-90% utilised in Q4
triggers.quote: utilization was almost at about 80%, 90%, almost full capacity we utilized until the end of the year

triggers.label: Rare-earth capex ramp: INR 40-50 cr PML plus INR 40-50 cr Quantum
triggers.quote: It could be between INR 40 crores to INR 50 crores for PML itself and another INR 40 crores to INR 50 crores could be the plan in Quantum, roughly.

triggers.label: Rare-earth revenue nil in FY26
triggers.quote: There was no revenue in FY26 because of the restrictions from China for export of magnets.
triggers.highlight: There was no revenue in FY26

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 20-30% guided
triggers.quote: On revenue front, you can consider maybe 20% to 30% depending on what orders we click.

guidance.quote: On revenue front, you can consider maybe 20% to 30% depending on what orders we click.
Yes, EBITDA, roughly that level, 15%, 17%. 15% to 18% you can say.

guidance.value: from H2 FY27; INR 25-50 crore revenue in FY27
guidance.quote: we can expect maybe in FY27 maybe between INR 25 crores to INR 50 crores, maybe something like this could be possible.
the Phase 2 capex covering block cutting, machining and surface treatment is expected to be implemented in quarter 3, quarter 4 of financial year '27

guidance.value: Q4 FY27 for Phase 2; 5,000 t plan around FY30-31
guidance.quote: that commercial sales, we will mostly start by quarter 4 of 2027.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are behind the original timelines with commercial ramp-up now expected from second half of financial year '27

prior_guidance_check.metric: Assembly turnover FY26 INR 5-10 crore expectation
prior_guidance_check.quote: There was no revenue in FY26 because of the restrictions from China for export of magnets.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Chinese restrictions easing after Q3 or Jan-Feb
prior_guidance_check.quote: No, we did not get any approval for our products that we were importing.

red_flags.label: Relays and rare-earth timelines repeatedly slipped
red_flags.quote: Testing is currently underway and customer approvals are in progress, both of which have taken longer than our initial expectations.

red_flags.label: Analyst says two years of slipped commercialisation
red_flags.quote: Last 2 years, we have been expecting the commercialization and ramping up to happen, but it's been actually a very poor show, I would say.

evasions.quote: We are yet evaluating the scheme, and that decision will be made
I can't comment exactly on the numbers.
So, we will do a combination, maybe in debt and equity, maybe we will do. That we are yet to finalize.
